Would you like to add Sight's Stata commands ("vview" and "browse")?

"vview" opens datasets in VS Code; in console Stata, "browse" (and its abbreviations "brows", "brow", "bro", "br") becomes an alias for it (the GUI built-in "browse" is unaffected).

Install location: C:\Users\jmb\ado\personal
sight console will take over the open Stata (Stata/MP 18.0 - C:\Program Files\Stata18\ado\base\a\auto.dta). It closes when the console ends, so unsaved work in it would be lost then.
sight console can't use Stata here: you chose to keep your open Stata to yourself. send-to-stata sends to it without taking it over. Send code to the open Stata window instead?
